title: Social Neuroscience & Person-Space Manifold Literature Corpus
description: Foundational full-text papers establishing the intrinsic dimensionality, representational geometry, hippocampal cognitive mapping, and Theory-of-Mind state-space mechanics for Aura's person-space manifold engine.

papers.title: The brain represents people as the mental states they habitually experience
papers.mathematical_mechanistic_insight: Establishes the Summation Model of Person-Space Geometry via Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) in the social brain network (dmPFC, vmPFC, precuneus, TPJ, ATL). A person p's neural representation r_p is the stationary probability-weighted linear expectation over the low-dimensional 3D mental state manifold (Rationality, Social Impact, Valence): r_p = sum_{m in M} P(m | p) v_m. This yields a positive semi-definite person-similarity kernel K_person(p_i, p_j) = p_i^T Sigma_M p_j, bridging fast transient mental-state trajectories v_m(t) and slow invariant person coordinates r_p via ergodic expectation.

papers.title: Neural representations of situations and mental states are composed of sums of representations of the actions they afford
papers.mathematical_mechanistic_insight: Proves a 3-tier compositional linear operator hierarchy (Actions -> Mental States & Situations -> Persons). Neural representations of mental states v_m and situations s_c decompose as conditional probability-weighted sums over a 6D action-affordance basis (ACT-FAST: Abstraction, Creation, Tradition, Food, Animacy, Spiritualism): v_m = sum_k P(a_k | m) a_k and s_c = sum_k P(a_k | c) a_k. Combined with Thornton et al. (2019), person representations factorize as r_p = P_{p->m} P_{m->a} A, enabling zero-shot prediction of person-situation behavioral compatibility via inner products in the shared action-affordance subspace.

papers.title: Social avoidance can be quantified as navigation in abstract social space
papers.mathematical_mechanistic_insight: Formalizes the 2D Hippocampal Social Navigation Manifold (Power x Affiliation) in Euclidean and polar coordinates relative to the self. Each interactant j traces a kinematic trajectory x_j(t) = (A_j(t), P_j(t)) in [-1, 1]^2 with egocentric social vector angle theta_j(t) = atan2(P_j, A_j), Euclidean social distance d_j(t) = ||x_j(t) - x_self||_2, step-velocity ||Delta x_j(t)||_2, vector consistency, and convex-hull area of social exploration. Provides exact state-update equations for Aura's relational manifold tracker from discrete dyadic choices.

papers.title: Abstract representations emerge in human hippocampal neurons during inference
papers.mathematical_mechanistic_insight: Demonstrates in human hippocampal single-neuron recordings how abstract inference reorganizes neural state space into a low-dimensional, disentangled geometry with parallel coding axes across orthogonal latent variables. Contributes two rigorous geometric metrics to Aura's science/ validation suite: (1) Shattering Dimensionality (SD), the mean linear decoding accuracy across all balanced binary dichotomies of latent configurations, and (2) Cross-Condition Generalization Performance (CCGP) and Coding Vector ParallelismScore (cosine similarity of linear decision normals across held-out social/task contexts).

papers.title: Map-like representations of emotion knowledge in hippocampal-prefrontal systems
papers.mathematical_mechanistic_insight: Unifies continuous 2D affective manifolds (Valence x Arousal) with Tolman-Eichenbaum cognitive map theory and Successor Representations (SR) in the hippocampal-prefrontal (vmPFC/dmPFC) circuit. Shows that neural similarity simultaneously reflects Euclidean metric distance in the 2D conceptual manifold and multi-step Markov transition proximity M = (I - gamma T)^{-1} built from empirical emotion transition matrices T_{ij} = P(e_{t+1}=j | e_t=i). Directly parameterizes Aura's predictive affective state-transition prior and geodesic manifold distance.

papers.title: Machine Theory of Mind
papers.venue: Proceedings of the 35th International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), PMLR 80:4218-4227
papers.mathematical_mechanistic_insight: Formulates the ToMnet meta-learning observer architecture that explicitly factorizes an observed agent's state into a slow, episode-invariant character embedding e_char in R^{d_c} (aggregated over past behavioral trajectories) and a fast, dynamic mental-state embedding e_mental,t in R^{d_m} (updated recurrently within the current episode) to predict action distributions pi(a_t | s_t, e_char, e_mental,t) and false beliefs. Proves that low-dimensional bottleneck embeddings spontaneously recover the intrinsic coordinates of agent personality/preference parameters without explicit trait labels.

papers.title: Neural manifold analysis of brain circuit dynamics in health and disease
papers.mathematical_mechanistic_insight: Synthesizes the mathematical foundations for estimating Intrinsic Dimensionality (d_int << N) and latent dynamical flows dot{z} = f(z) on low-dimensional manifolds embedded in high-dimensional observation spaces R^N. Details spectral participation ratio PR = (sum lambda_i)^2 / sum lambda_i^2, geodesic graph distances (Isomap), topological neighborhood graphs (UMAP/MIND), and Procrustes/CCA cross-subject manifold alignment, providing the core dimensionality-estimation and manifold-alignment algorithms for Aura's science/ engine.
